summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a 6-K reporting a board resolution to merge its wholly-owned fiber subsidiary, Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Ótica S.A., into itself. The merger is based on an appraisal report prepared by PriceWaterhouseCoopers valuing Fibrasil's equity at R$ 812.6 million (book value as of Dec 31, 2025). The board recommends the merger, aiming to simplify structure, speed decisions, optimize operations, and reduce costs. Fibrasil is wholly owned, so no third-party consideration or premium applies; shares will be canceled. An EGM will be called to approve. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory clearance under Brazilian law.
